# Fork lifetime, named disable and capture cleanup (SIM-010)

The task module runs every positive fixture through the public CLI in both HDL
optimizer modes on legacy, compact/portable and compact/GMP values (GMP when
`LLG_TEST_GMP_ROOT` is set). Expected outputs are derived by hand from the
cited clauses, not captured from llg.

| Fixture | Clause and independent oracle |
| --- | --- |
| `fork_declarations` | §§6.21, 9.3.2. Each iteration's fork creates its own `k` = 10 + `i` before its branch starts. The branches start after `spawn` returns at time 0, when the shared loop variable `i` is 3 and still alive for them; each waits `13 - k`: `k 12 i 3` at 1, `k 11 i 3` at 2, `k 10 i 3` at 3. `wait fork` in the calling process waits for all three: `done 3`. |
| `shared_automatics` | §§6.21, 9.3.2. In `t`, the parent writes `x = 7` right after the fork, so the child at 2 prints 7 and writes 9, which the parent prints at 3. Each `outlive(n)` returns at once after setting `y = 10n`; its child prints `y` at +3: 40 and 60. Two branches each increment the block's `z` (at 1 and 2): 2 at 3. In `loop`, the three branches start after the loop ends and read the one `i`: 3 each time. |
| `shared_strings` | §§6.21, 9.3.2. The parent sets `s = "b"` right after the fork; the child prints `b k` at 1 and appends `!`, which the parent prints at 2 (`b!`). In `copy_only` the joined branch copies `m` into its own `mine`: `copy m`. |
| `shared_containers` | §§6.21, 9.3.2. The producer pushes 10, 20, 30 at 1, 2, 3; the consumer pops one element just after each push (`#1` then `#0`) into the task's `got`: `got 10 20 30`. `detached` pushes 1 after starting its branch and returns at 3; the branch pushes 7 at 5 into the same queue: size 2. |
| `joined_strings` | §§6.21, 9.3.2. Joined branches append `b` at 1 and `c` at 2 to the task's `s` (`"a"`), then `y` and `z` to the block's `s` (`"x"`): `task abc`, `block xyz`. |
| `fork_wakeups` | §§9.4.2, 9.4.3. `bare` (called at 0) wakes when its branch sets `l` at 2; `edge_expr` (at 2) on `posedge (level & idle)` at 4; `real_change` (at 4) when `r` becomes 2.5 at 5; `level_wait` (at 5) when `x` becomes 2 at 7. The parent sets `b` at 8 and wakes its detached branch: `branch 8`. Joined siblings: `y` becomes 2 at 10: `sibling 10`. Storing the unchanged 2 at 11 is no event; 3 at 12 wakes: `changed y=3 12`. |
| `shared_formals` | §§9.3.2, 13.3. `t(1)`: the parent sets `v` to 7 after the fork; the branch prints 7 at 2 and sets 9; the parent prints 9 at 3 and returns it: `out 9`. `loop_spawn(5)` adds 100 before its two branches print at 4: `n=105` twice. `waiter(0)` (at 5) wakes when its branch sets the formal at 6. `outs(a, b)` (at 6, `b` = 3): the branch sets `r` to 5 and increments `io` at 7 after the parent's `r = 1`; the parent prints at 8 and the outputs are copied out: `outs r=5 io=4`, `a=5 b=4`. `outlive("hi", 1.25)` returns at 8 after appending `!` and doubling `r`; its branch prints at 12: `outlive hi! 2.5 12`. |
| `shared_records` | §§6.21, 9.3.2. `detached` (0-2): its branch pushes 5 at 1 and starts a nested fork; the task sets `a` = 2, `s` = `y` at 0, pushes 6 at 2: `parent 3`; the nested branch prints at 3, after the task returned: `nested 2 y 3 6`. `joined` (2-4): branches set `a` = 5 at 3 and `s` = `j` at 4: `joined 5 j`. `nested_queue` (4-6): pushes at 4, 5 (branch) and 6; the nested branch prints at 7: `queue 3`. |
| `container_waits` | §§9.4.3, 9.3.2. The branch pushes 1 into `q` at 2 and 7 into `r.q` at 4; each `wait` resumes at that store: `queue 1 2`, `record queue 7 4`. |
| `disable_scope` | §§9.6.2, 9.6.3. `a`'s `disable fork` at 2 ends `worker(1)` and the branch it forked; `b`'s `worker(2)` prints its branch at 5 and returns at 10. At 21 `disable sleeper` ends both activations started at 20: no `s3`/`s4` lines. |
| `kill_suspensions` | §§9.6.3, 9.4. At 1 `disable fork` ends ten branches waiting on a delay, a named event, `@` and `wait` on shared automatics, a module signal edge, a semaphore, a mailbox, a task call, `wait fork` and a `wait` over shared string, queue and record; the task then writes every shared variable and the initial block triggers the event, signal, semaphore and mailbox: only `killed 1` and `end 101`. |
| `container_formals` | §§9.3.2, 13.3. `t('{1, 2})`: the joined branch reads the formal at 1: `join 2`. `d('{1}, r)` (at 1): the task pushes 9; its branch prints the size at 2 (`branch 2`), pushes 8 and pushes 3 into the output; the task prints at 3: `parent 3 8`; `r` is copied out: `out 1 3`. |
| `recursive_lifetimes` | §§9.3.2, 9.6.2, 13.3. `ping(3)` at 0 → `pong(2)` at 1 → `ping(1)` at 2 → `pong(0)` at 3; all return at 3: `returned 3`. Each `pong` disables its `drop` branch 1 after starting it, before it prints; `keep` prints 3 after: `pong keep 2 4`, `pong keep 0 6`. Each `ping` child prints its activation's `n` 5 after: `ping child 3 5`, `ping child 1 7`. |
